verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a vendor API with OAuth 2 and PKCE that supports appending data to notes and returning bookmarked links, so an agent can write to notes headlessly in a limited way. The evidence does not show reading note contents. Deep links run through the installed app, so they are not truly headless. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: documented read access to note contents, full create/update/edit endpoints beyond append, an MCP server or local API, a published API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
